method.limits: Session spans include waits and are not active effort. Nested tool counts count syntactic tools.* call sites, not executed iterations. Cumulative thread usage is last observed value, never summed across snapshots; cached input is included and costs are unknown. Whitespace words undercount compressed prompts. No source=model_provider inference. Latest sessions can continue beyond captured excerpts; snapshot completeness is not final technical disposition. Metadata/report counts are fixed to each recorded observed_end cutoff; source logs may subsequently grow.
